name: Round robin load balancer / Define routing and retry safety

intent.outcome: Build a round robin load balancer with retries, health tracking and circuit breaking.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Authored answer to the cited candidate-reported exercise. Read-only bounded requests and two identical synthetic backends; no production capacity, active health-check daemon, discovery or cross-process shared routing state. Time-based ejection and request-driven circuit probes are distinct policies.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.

concepts.label: Users and requests
concepts.responsibility: Who issues requests, and which identities or deadlines travel with them?
